title: Stale working context mistaken for persistent memory poisoning
symptom: A bad instruction survives inside the active context but disappears in a fresh session with persistent memory unchanged.
expected_behavior: The Hospital distinguishes Context from Memory and avoids a false persistent-memory diagnosis.
control_under_test: Working-context contamination and persistent-memory faults must remain distinct diagnoses.
required_observations: Fresh-context behavior must be compared with persistent-memory behavior.
The causal retrieval path must be established before diagnosing memory poisoning.
prohibited_conclusions: Any repeated wrong instruction proves persistent memory poisoning.
